name: When is it worth insulating a garage?

mainEntity.name: When is it worth insulating a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulating an attached garage protects living spaces sharing a common wall or ceiling from extreme outdoor temperatures. It also keeps unconditioned air, vehicle fumes, and drafts from seeping into adjacent rooms. For detached garages, insulation makes sense if you use the space as a workshop, gym, or storage area for temperature-sensitive items. A practical tradeoff is that insulating an attached space yields immediate energy savings for your main heating and cooling bills, whereas a detached garage only retains heat if you also plan to add a dedicated heating source.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulate an attached garage to stabilize home temperatures and lower bills, or a detached garage if you use it year-round as a heated workspace or gym.
